description: Fork of exp377 (out_canon after out_proj). Unembedder now sees concatenated per-layer out_dom (±1 pair-dominance, 6×496=2976 dims) via a single Linear(2976, 257), instead of concat of Borda+LN(out_dom) through the old MLP. LUTBlock.forward returns (out, out_dom); Model.forward collects out_dom across layers. Tests whether the ±1 pair-dominance is directly useful to a Linear readout (bypassing the Borda+LN compression to 32 dims per layer).
